title: Unsupervised Detection of Contextualized Embedding Bias with Application to Ideology
reasoning: The paper includes a specific analysis (Section 6.4, 'Semantic Probing of X*') that evaluates embeddings based on morality ratings. It investigates how ideological bias in language models relates to moral-like reasoning and abstract evaluative semantics, using human-provided morality scores as a benchmark for interpreting its findings.
